g.title: crate Reactive runtime, async tasks, and frame-driven motion for Kivact apps.
crate::host Runtime construction and task and motion turn operations.
crate::machine Run owner-scoped state machines with queued events, effects, and timers.
crate::motion Animation system with frame-driven updates.
crate::motion::animated `Animated<T>`: a value that follows a `Value<T>` by a `Transition`.
crate::motion::frame_loop Frame loop callbacks and refresh timing.
crate::motion::stagger `Stagger`: the delay of each item of a list, measured from an origin.
crate::motion::state This module stores motion state and frame loop records.
crate::motion::timeline `Timeline`: tracks that move along one clock, with labels, calls,
crate::motion::timeline::api The `Timeline` value, its tracks, segments and playback cell.
crate::motion::timeline::calls The calls a playback move crosses, in every repetition.
crate::motion::timeline::curve The value of a timeline's track segment at a time: a timed
crate::motion::timeline::plan The segments of a timeline and their per-track plan: each track's
crate::motion::timeline::segment The segments of a timeline: a track's move or a call, with its span.
crate::motion::values Frame timing values and shared interpolation vocabulary.
crate::reactive Reactive runtime and public handle types for Kivact apps.
crate::reactive::clock Runtime clock and wake scheduling.
crate::reactive::data Passive runtime state and handle identities.
crate::reactive::detail The detailed turn trace the DevTools reads (hidden from the public API).

crate::reactive::error `UiError`, handler results and misuse panics.
crate::reactive::execution Thread-local identity of the executing app.
crate::reactive::ext Per-app extension state for subsystems.
crate::reactive::frame Copy execution contexts and runtime-owned dependency collectors.
crate::reactive::graph Reactive graph with three-color push-pull propagation.
crate::reactive::handler Shared event outcomes and erased effectful handlers.
crate::reactive::handles Public Copy handles: Signal, Value, Var, Callback, Binding.
crate::reactive::host Host wake boundary, turn stages and reactive turn operations.
crate::reactive::host_types Host wake contracts and passive turn status values.
crate::reactive::identity Opaque App, owner and graph node identities.
crate::reactive::keyed Keyed rows that keep their owner while their key stays (`mapArray`).
crate::reactive::mounts Typed queues for unstamped and acknowledged mount callbacks.
crate::reactive::object Owner-bound objects and their lifecycle management.
crate::reactive::owner Owner tree and hierarchical resource disposal.
crate::reactive::owner_handle Copy handles to owners and to the objects stored under them.
crate::reactive::props Property value abstraction and render effects.
crate::reactive::registry Thread-local app registry and handle lookup.
crate::reactive::report Error routing to handlers and diagnostic sinks.
crate::reactive::runtime Runtime construction and shared arena queries.
crate::reactive::scope Locate the owner and runtime of public setup calls.
crate::reactive::sealed Public-in-bounds traits that only this crate can name or implement.
crate::reactive::selector `Selector`: O(1) "is this key selected" reads (Solid `createSelector`).
crate::reactive::setup Free setup functions for reactive state and effects.
crate::reactive::trigger Value-free dependencies that computations track and writers notify.
crate::reactive::turn Effect scheduling within a turn.
crate::task Async task execution and lifecycle.
crate::task::action `Action<T, I>`: a user-triggered async operation with a run policy.
crate::task::async_adapters Adapt resources and actions to the async source contract.
crate::task::async_publication Passive async publication identity and retry callbacks.
crate::task::async_source Sealed contract for standard async view sources.
crate::task::async_state `AsyncState<T>`: the one state shape of resources and actions.
crate::task::blocking Blocking operations with cancellation support.
crate::task::completion This module provides one-shot futures for host results.
crate::task::drain Drain of queued actions on owner disposal, `close` and App exit.
crate::task::latest The one in-flight run of latest-wins work (a resource fetch, a `Latest` run).
crate::task::sealed Public-in-bounds traits that only this crate can name or implement.
crate::task::spawn This module runs owned futures on the UI thread.
crate::task::state Task state tracking and completion.
crate::task::tokio_bridge Run Send futures on one lazily created Tokio runtime per App.
crate::task::tokio_state Own the lifecycle of the App's single Tokio executor.
crate::task::worker_pool Worker threads that run blocking jobs, and their shutdown.
